description: This file is an abstract base class for a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter used in the Eclipse Hono project. It provides core functionalities for managing HTTP servers, routing, tracing, metrics, and message handling for devices via HTTP, including telemetry, event, and command responses. It defines the structure for subclasses to implement specific routing logic and handles complex interactions like device commands, time-to-disconnect features, and integration with tracing and metrics systems.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational implementation for an HTTP protocol adapter in Eclipse Hono, managing server lifecycle, routing, tracing, metrics, and message processing logic.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the HTTP servers with configured routes, setting up tracing, metrics, and request handling.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures a Vert.x Router with shared handlers for metrics, tracing, logging, failure handling, request size limits, and tenant-specific trace sampling.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to register custom route handlers.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Handles the uploading of telemetry data from devices to Hono.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Handles uploading event messages from devices.

methods.name: uploadCommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Uploads command response messages from devices back to Hono.
